top._headline: Chevron Duvernay Decision Window Open — Act This Week
top._insight: With mud contracts historically awarded 3-4 weeks post-permit on Chevron Canada's Kaybob South pad program, the vendor selection window is closing right now, making this the highest-urgency actionable lead in the set.
